Definition
[Exponential map and cut locus] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0429, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0430 ↗ thm:chow-iii-g49-tangent-cone 1. appG:G.50\group Aleksandrov structure

Let $\Omega _p$ consist of cone vectors $[(v,t)]$ realized by geodesics from $p$. Define $\exp _p([(v,t)])=x$ at the endpoint and let $C(p)$ be the cut locus; $C_p\subset \Omega _p$ consists of vectors ending in $C(p)$.
